# WorkBench

> WorkBench is free field service management software for home-service teams
> (plumbing, HVAC, electrical, cleaning, lawn care, and similar trades). It
> covers the whole job lifecycle — online booking, lead pipeline, quotes with
> e-signature, scheduling and dispatch, time tracking, team chat, one-click
> invoicing, built-in card/ACH payments, recurring billing, and a client
> portal. That core software is free for unlimited users; WorkBench is
> funded by a flat processing fee (2.9% + 30¢ per card transaction, 0.75%
> per ACH transfer) only when a client pays through it — no monthly fees, no
> minimums, no paywalled tiers. WorkBench also includes Atlas, a built-in AI
> assistant — Atlas is NOT part of the free plan: every account gets free
> trial tokens to try it, and ongoing use is billed on its own usage-based
> plan, separate from the free core software, because AI usage has a real
> cost. A native iPhone app is on the App Store; the web app runs on any
> device. Access is invite-only: a short application and a standard
> payment-verification (KYC) form, then a person reviews and onboards each
> company personally, usually within a business day. Built by Streamflaire,
> based in the Dallas–Fort Worth, TX area.

## Product

- [Home](https://workbenchfsm.com/): Overview, the free pricing model, trades supported, and the mobile app.
- [Features](https://workbenchfsm.com/features): The complete feature catalog across four stages — win the work, run the day, get paid, keep clients close — plus Atlas and mobile.
- [Pricing](https://workbenchfsm.com/pricing): The full breakdown of the free-software / flat-processing-fee model, exact rates, and FAQ.
- [Get started](https://workbenchfsm.com/apply): The application flow — how a company gets onboarded.
- [Roadmap](https://workbenchfsm.com/roadmap): What's shipped and what's coming next.

## Feature deep-dives

- [Scheduling & dispatch](https://workbenchfsm.com/features/scheduling-dispatch): Drag-to-schedule calendars, recurring visit series, team map, roles & permissions.
- [Payments](https://workbenchfsm.com/features/payments): Card & ACH rates, saved cards & autopay, recurring billing, payment reminders, payouts & refunds.
- [Quotes & invoicing](https://workbenchfsm.com/features/quotes-and-invoicing): E-signature quotes, deposits, follow-ups, one-click invoicing, the shared price book.
- [Client portal](https://workbenchfsm.com/features/client-portal): The magic-link client hub — messaging, agreements, notifications, review requests.
- [Time tracking](https://workbenchfsm.com/features/time-tracking): Clock-in/out, timesheets, the team map, and labor cost flowing into job profitability.
- [Atlas AI assistant](https://workbenchfsm.com/features/atlas): What Atlas does, its permission model, and its pricing (free trial tokens, then its own usage-based plan — not part of the free core plan).
